name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window over a dimmed page, with a close button in the corner.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./dialog.css";
import { Dialog as DialogRoot } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogEmits, DialogProps, DialogSlots } from "./types.ts";

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>("open", { default: undefined });
const { defaultOpen = false } = defineProps<DialogProps>();
defineEmits<DialogEmits>();
defineSlots<DialogSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogRoot v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen || undefined"><slot /></DialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogClose as DialogClosePart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogCloseSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<DialogCloseSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogClosePart data-slot="dialog-close"><slot /></DialogClosePart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { X } from "@lucide/vue";
import { DialogBackdrop, DialogClose, DialogContent as DialogContentPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogContentProps, DialogContentSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const { closeLabel = "Close" } = defineProps<DialogContentProps>();
defineSlots<DialogContentSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogBackdrop data-slot="dialog-backdrop" />
  <DialogContentPart v-bind="$attrs" data-slot="dialog-content">
    <slot />
    <!-- An empty `close` slot removes the button. -->
    <slot name="close">
      <DialogClose data-slot="dialog-close" :aria-label="closeLabel"><X aria-hidden="true" /></DialogClose>
    </slot>
  </DialogContentPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogDescription as DialogDescriptionPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogDescriptionSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<DialogDescriptionSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogDescriptionPart data-slot="dialog-description"><slot /></DialogDescriptionPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogTitle as DialogTitlePart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogTitleSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<DialogTitleSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogTitlePart data-slot="dialog-title"><slot /></DialogTitlePart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogTrigger as DialogTriggerPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/dialog";
import type { DialogTriggerSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<DialogTriggerSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <DialogTriggerPart data-slot="dialog-trigger"><slot /></DialogTriggerPart>
</template>
